summary: A Georgia lookout list gives a Charlton County tower named 'clarking' at an elevation of 173 (feet, if so 52.7 m); no history found.

evidence.supports: tnlandforms list entry: tower named clarking in Charlton County, elevation 173 with no unit, registers BLL-65229 and gfc-833, and the label st george
tnlandforms page is a bare Georgia lookout list with no site description

corrections.why: The list writes the name in lower case. Title case matches the list's other tower names. The label 'st george' sits in the same row and is unexplained, so the name needs an editor's check.

notes_for_editor: Only one list names this tower (tnlandforms GA174). The name appears in lower case, and the row adds the label 'st george', which may be a second name or a community; the list does not say. Two searches for St. George or Charlton County fire towers found nothing confirmed for this site (an antenna pole registry entry and the Eddy Fire Tower in the Okefenokee area, neither linked to this tower). The elevation unit is assumed to be feet. No status, access or history found. Confidence low.
